exposure: gestational age at previous Cesarean section
cohort: Women with a history of cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) at a single hospital over a 40-month period (n=9)
finding: The incidence of CSP was 0.25% of all cesarean sections, and the majority of women with CSP had undergone a previous cesarean section without labor, suggesting a possible link between indications for previous cesarean section and CSP risk.
mod_finding: This study suggests that cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) may be related to the indications for the previous cesarean section, particularly cesarean deliveries performed without labor, rather than the number of previous cesarean sections alone.
